segments.ja355:1.1: Aññe socanti rodanti, aññe assumukhā janā;
segments.ja355:1.3: Pasannamukhavaṇṇosi, kasmā ghaṭa [ghata (sī. pī.)] na socasi.
segments.ja355:2.3: Tasmā dhaṅka [vaṃka (pī.)] na socāmi, natthi soke dutīyatā [soko dutīyakā (ka.)].
segments.ja355:3.1: Socaṃ paṇḍu kiso hoti, bhattañcassa na ruccati;
segments.ja355:4.1: Gāme vā yadi vāraññe, ninne vā yadi vā thale;
segments.ja355:4.3: Ṭhitaṃ maṃ nāgamissati, evaṃ diṭṭhapado ahaṃ.
segments.ja355:5.3: Sabbāpi pathavī tassa, na sukhaṃ āvahissatīti.
